exposure: performing elective cesarean sections in a main theater rather than a labor ward
cohort: 1682 women undergoing cesarean section (elective and emergency)
finding: Incremental implementation of a maternal SSI prevention care bundle, including ChloraPrep, PICO dressings, dedicated operating room for elective procedures, vaginal cleansing, and Hibiscrub, was associated with a significant reduction in SSI rates following cesarean section.
